Ozeryany Old Jewish Cemetery (Ternopil Region)

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. The Yizkor memorial book for Ozeryany retells a local tradition that this, the town's Old cemetery, was established 'in the late Middle Ages' — though the source itself notes there is no actual evidence of either the cemetery's early existence or Jewish presence in Ozeryany at that time, suggesting the tradition may be legendary. The same Yizkor book describes an ohel here belonging to Yeshaiahu Ha-Levi Heller, a descendant of the noted rabbinic commentator known as Tosafot Yom Tov, whose family members used to visit the site.
